data.title: AeroVironment: Buy Rating Reiterated on Strong Growth Visibility and Program Catalysts, Price Target Maintained at $326
data.description:
Noah Poponak, an analyst from Goldman Sachs, maintained the Buy rating on AeroVironment. The associated price target remains the same with $326.00.

Noah Poponak has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including AeroVironment’s solid near-term growth outlook and high revenue visibility. The company is guiding to roughly 10% year-over-year revenue expansion for FY27 and reports that about 86% of that revenue is already visible, supported by a 37% increase in funded backlog and ongoing drawdowns on domestic and international IDIQ contracts, including potential P550 task orders exceeding $500 million.

Poponak also highlights emerging program catalysts that can drive meaningful upside beyond FY27. The first international LOCUST order, valued at over $50 million, and its demonstrated effectiveness in cutting drone activity materially are expected to spur further global demand, with revenue ramping into FY29. In parallel, the Freedom Eagle (FE-1) missile benefits from robust bipartisan support, customer-led development, an attractive sub-$150,000 unit cost, and the prospect of accelerated entry into low-rate initial production, all reinforcing his favorable long-term view at an unchanged $326 price target.

data.title: Walmart: Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Tariff-Funded Pricing Strategy Drives Earnings Momentum; $132 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
Goldman Sachs analyst Kate McShane maintained a Buy rating on Walmart yesterday and set a price target of $132.00.

Kate McShane has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Walmart’s current operating momentum and strategic choices. She notes that management is seeing a generally resilient consumer, with solid back-to-school and college seasons, and believes Walmart’s focus on value and convenience positions it well to capture spend, particularly as gas prices stay elevated and pressure lower-income shoppers.

Kate McShane’s rating is based on Walmart’s use of tariff refunds to aggressively reinvest in pricing, especially in food, consumables and seasonal categories, which is helping the company gain market share while mitigating fuel-related cost pressures. She expects these price actions, combined with Walmart’s competitive delivery speed and improving profitability profile, to underpin solid earnings growth through 2026, supporting her unchanged $132 price target and Buy recommendation.

data.title: Gap Inc. Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Transformation Progress Drives Market Share and Margin Gains; Price Target Maintained at $27
data.description:
Goldman Sachs analyst Brooke Roach maintained a Buy rating on Gap Inc yesterday and set a price target of $27.00.

Brooke Roach has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with Gap Inc.’s steady progress on its transformation agenda. Management reported gaining market share in key segments, improving margins, and building momentum across most brands, while keeping the price target unchanged at $27.

Brooke Roach’s rating is based on the view that recent challenges at Old Navy are largely temporary and already being addressed. The company has realigned assortments, sharpened value-focused marketing, and is benefiting from resilient consumer demand, growing interest in 1990s nostalgia, and stronger in-store experiences, which together support a constructive outlook for the stock.
